description: Header file defining functions and variables for managing temporary directories and sandboxes in testing environment.

methods.name: is_valid_tmp_path
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a valid writable directory and within maximum path length.

methods.name: find_tmp_path
methods.description: Attempts to find a suitable temporary directory path from environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: canonicalize_tmp_path
methods.description: Converts a path to its canonical form, normalizing slashes and resolving real paths.

methods.name: clar_tempdir_shutdown
methods.description: Cleans up the temporary directory, changing directory up and removing the temp dir.

methods.name: build_tempdir_path
methods.description: Builds and creates a temporary directory path, handling platform-specific temp directory creation.

methods.name: clar_tempdir_init
methods.description: Initializes the temporary directory, creating and changing into it, and seeding the RNG.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a string to a destination, replacing ':' with '_' in the source.

methods.name: clar_sandbox_create
methods.description: Creates a sandbox directory for a test, named based on suite and test names or random hex.

methods.name: clar_sandbox_cleanup
methods.description: Removes the sandbox directory and resets sandbox path.

methods.name: clar_tempdir_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the temporary directory.

methods.name: clar_sandbox_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the current sandbox directory.
